steps.text: To the north of Kazdel lies a birch forest.
There, the progression of life unfolds. From Spring it begins, and in Winter it ceases.
And only death thrives in the long winters. All living things make their exodus in unison, leaving only the Originium crystals speckled along the ground to reflect the somber moonlight.
...Pale, withered tree trunks hang lifelessly, their slender shadows intertwining and stacking upon empty expanses of snow.
That is the scenery I saw.
...Ines!
...Ines! Tch!
...Screw you!

steps.name: W
steps.text: If you're not dead yet, then wake up already.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: (My head... what is this pain...?)

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: What's going on... what happened?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Nothing happened, but just in case that fall gave you amnesia, I'll give you a quick summary.

steps.name: W
steps.text: We were ambushed an hour ago. They were quick. Our caster had no time to put up a barrier, and our team got split up. We're the only ones here.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: And the comms?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Jammed. I don't know how they're doing it, but we're definitely up against pros. At least more professional than any of our prey before.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But the good news is they didn't go straight for the convoy. Looks like they got a tip or something, but not the details.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Go ahead. Find a way to meet up with the others.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh? I figured you'd doubt me, at least a little.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Guess I'll leave you as bait.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Who do you think would survive if we fought?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Obviously—

steps.name: W
steps.text: Tsk... You really should do something about that nasty personality of yours. You can tell I'm injured that easy?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Oh... so it hurts that bad, huh?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I figured you had some control over your emotions, like you could fake them. Guess I was being more careful than I needed to be.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Do you always scan your teammates with Arts as soon as you wake up? Now that's a mark of trust, boss.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Force of habit.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So that's why, huh? The first thing you do after you open your eyes is surveil your surroundings. What a coward~

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hey! That hurts...!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You said bait, right? Not a bad idea.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: No point in dragging along a merc who can't even stand up straight. You stay here for a sec and I'll call in the enemy.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hope you guys get along nicely. Can't have you dying on me too quickly.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: See you later, W.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Oh, one last thing. I never trusted you.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hey, you little—!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...I found a mercenary. Just one.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Confirmation. It's W.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...That was fast.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Or rather, you've been following us the whole time, huh...?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Letting a few of them go was well worth it if it means we can get our hands on an HVT like you.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Hmph. I was gonna follow you back to the rest of your team. Never expected them to just abandon one of their own.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Tell me everything you know about them and you might get a quick death.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Well there's the trouble, huh? ...I'd love for us to be honest with each other, but the truth is that I don't know anything.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You're badly wounded. And we don't have time to waste. You might die if we torture you on the spot, and I'm sure nobody wants that.

steps.name: W
steps.text: In that case, you should chase down that woman. She knows more than I do.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...Don't you resent her for using you as bait?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You'll have a better time if you work with us.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Bait, huh?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Say... Have you ever baited Originium slugs with industrial residue before?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...What are you talking about?

steps.name: W
steps.text: It's kind of a Kazdel folk thing. We get Originium slug infestations, you know?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Wild Originium slugs are pretty dumb, and they like Originium—

steps.name: W
steps.text: —But setting that aside, do you know what happens to the poor slugs that are lured over?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Don't mince words with—

steps.name: W
steps.text: They get blown apart, just like your buddies over there.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What?! When did you...?!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hey, you even said I was bait. Didn't you think that meant a trap?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Probably should've killed me sooner, or ran off, I guess. Here, I'll give you another chance. Let's take it from the top.

steps.name: W
steps.text: *cough* *cough*——

steps.name: W
steps.text: —So fast?! Have you been chasing us this whole time?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You're insane!!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Ugh... Who's... behind...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hush. No sudden movements.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: It's kind of a beginner sword, but I'm not so good with a blade. If my hand slips, you die.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: When— When did you get—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I'm pretty close with the shadows. Did you really think you'd be able to catch me without a scout?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Speak up. Who's your master?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: I'll... never—

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Graaaaahhh!!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Easy there. How's a guy supposed to talk if you turn his organs to mush?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Kazdel will... never... forgive you...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: (Kazdel...)

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Mm, thank you.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You really suck at torture.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Damn. You're still alive.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You could've let him kill me first. Too bad you're so impatient.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hmph. Of course I'd rather kill them first. These insects have taken too much from us.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: When the enemy shows you an opening, any merc worth her salt would kill him, no?

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Hah.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You really do have a bit of Sarkaz in you, huh?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Rubbed off on me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: That wasn't exactly quiet. I bet more of them are on the way.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Isn't that what we want? Keep them away from the objective.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: He said he let a couple get away... That means the rest are dead.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: He wasn't good enough to take down that many of our people. And he was definitely scared. There's... something else out here.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Whew.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Were you really faking your injury?

steps.name: W
steps.text: No no, you can't just fake an open wound away.

steps.name: W
steps.text: This is all mind over matter.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But let's talk about you. Did you really know that I had a present ready for them as soon as you woke up?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: If I didn't wake up, I would've been the bait.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I definitely would've waited for you to die before springing the trap.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: If one day, you meet someone who actually could read your mind...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You won't be a match for her.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I guess I'll cross that bridge when I come to it.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Can you feel around with Arts?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...As if I wasn't going to do that already.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: No...

steps.name: W
steps.text: That's the look that usually means we're boned.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You got that right.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But there's no running now. We press on.

steps.name: W
steps.text: And you suck at fighting, so it's all up to me?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Head west. We might be able to turn this around with Hoederer and his team.

steps.name: W
steps.text: And if we can't find them?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Then we die.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior?
steps.text: We wiped out half the escort team, but we couldn't stop the convoy before point A5.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior?
steps.text: They threw out a lot of decoys. Some of the most well-guarded ones were fakes.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior?
steps.text: Either Babel's pulling some next-level strats, or... the real one doesn't even need protection.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior?
steps.text: Yeah, we need to end this fast.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior?
steps.text: Thought we could leave mop-up operations to those scum... Didn't think they'd blow that too.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior?
steps.text: Their skills are all over the place. Hoederer's team was a lot tougher than I thought.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior?
steps.text: If Babel didn't score them first, would've been nice to get them for ourselves.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior?
steps.text: Do we keep chasing?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior?
steps.text: We don't know what's up ahead.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior?
steps.text: Understood, General.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We lost them?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Split up. You go east, I'll take the west.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Phew... phew...

steps.name: W
steps.text: These guys aren't easy marks.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Duh. Hide.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Pfah...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Knock it off. You've been at it since the beginning. You're gonna go blind. Don't your eyes hurt?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Of course they hurt, dumbass. But we have to find a way out...

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: Aieeeeee! I surrender!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ooh, what a nice, clean slash. Did you see that?

steps.name: W
steps.text: They're dressed up as mercs, but these aren't mercs.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Cut the chatter!

steps.name: W
steps.text: They don't even need to ambush us. They could take us head on in the ruins and we wouldn't be able to beat them.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: What are you thinking?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Huh...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Are you still spying on me? At a time like this?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: No. I just haven't gone blind yet.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You've got so many... are those grenades? What are you doing?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Are you gonna blow yourself up with them?

steps.name: W
steps.text: A kill's a kill, no?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Don't throw your life away for nothing.

steps.name: W
steps.text: For what then?

steps.name: W
steps.text: What's the point of living? What should I throw my life away for?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Sarkaz really are crazy.

steps.name: W
steps.text: That's why I never trusted you. You're not crazy.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hey, W! Wait!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Gah, come back!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Yep. Found one. The one and only W.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The way you toss those Originium grenades around, and such big ones too. That's the kind of crazy that gets my blood pumping.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: How do you do it? All my friends incinerated in a flash, and don't have a scratch on you?

steps.name: W
steps.text: What can I say? Practice makes perfect.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The General's gonna like you.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Just lay it all out for me. What's Babel got you doing? You can do a lot better somewhere else.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Why should you trust me?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Why should I trust you?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Asking the right questions in the right order.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Mercenaries are a tool of war. If we're gonna fight, we gotta have the right tools at hand.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Don't you think we're more expendable than that?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: That's your call.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We got another one hiding 17 meters out, 4 o'clock. The one with the scouting arts. You can think it over too.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Put the sword down. You can't beat me. Welcome to try though.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: What do you want?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Yeah... this fits. We got W and Ines.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You got maybe 20% of your people left. The scattered remnants can't do much.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: What's that you're standing on...?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Oh? This?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: It used to be a person. I guess it's hard to tell at this point.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You get it now? We're not your regular mercenaries. We're not hitmen either.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What if we do this? There's the two of you, plus your leader. Only one of you three has to die.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The other two bring back a head. I don't care whose. We pin all the losses on the head and take in the survivors.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Not that this is my call. But we have to do something for our fallen men.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Things could've gone a different way if we weren't meeting on the battlefield.

steps.name: W
steps.text: That's awful nice of you.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Just my luck. I suck at fighting. I probably can't beat this ugly bitch.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Now we're so honest all of a sudden.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Yeah, so the only other choice is for us to team up and kill Hoederer.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Yep. Hoederer.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: So——

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Tell me... why do mercenaries insist on getting killed?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'm not gonna stay on the side that's getting played. I'd much rather play with someone else's life.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Plus, I'm real sick of listening to you. You're boring. And your shitty little attempt at a death game sucks.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh, and my poor little lamb here steadily going blind...

steps.name: W
steps.text: She's not Sarkaz. You noticed, right? You stepped right into her minefield.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You know how this will end. You've already lost.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I dunno about that one...
Are you really going? The landship is right here.
Yes, I didn't expect them to spot it so soon. Did intel blow this one?
At least we've got the mercenaries.
We put them in danger. They have no idea what's happening.
They're mercenaries. They live for this. And sooner or later... it will be our burden too.
I can save them. I can save some of the men who would die for our mistakes.
You're right, Theresa, but...
There isn't a single Sarkaz, not a single person, who should die for nothing.
...*Sigh*... Then I'm coming with you.
Good. Thank you——
——Kal'tsit.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Wow, reinforcements, huh...? Who are they...?

steps.name: W
steps.text: There's a lot of them...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hey, you stay with me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Sorry... I'm just so... sleepy...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Since when do you know the word 'sorry?'

steps.name: W
steps.text: I had to watch you pass out last time... Now it's your turn...

steps.name: W
steps.text: C'mon, be a team player... I just need a little... nap...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Fourteen, fifteen... Still more...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: They're professionals. Look how they move... they know the battlefield even better than we do...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Kazdel... hmph...
Ine... Come in... someone...
Going... to save you...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Comms are back...?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: What... what's this feeling...?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Someone's close...!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Hoederer.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Ines! Where's W? What are your coordinates?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You lived in Kazdel... before the war... didn't you?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: There's something I have to ask...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Are you wounded? Catch your breath.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Find a safe place to hide. The convoy is going to call in reinforcements for us...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Just... listen to me, Hoederer.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Okay, I'm listening.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: The King of Sarkaz... The one who lost Kazdel... Her Majesty...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Is she... a woman with white hair?
